rules.name: Pytest marks and usefixtures should not be applied uselessly
Deprecated pytest.yield_fixture should be replaced with pytest.fixture
Composite assertions should be split
Pydantic models with dataclass fields should set "revalidate_instances" to "always"
FastAPI path parameters should be declared in route handlers or dependencies
Tests should use the "monkeypatch" fixture for temporary modifications
Test functions should declare fixture dependencies as parameters instead of using "request.getfixturevalue" with string literals
Pytest fixtures should contain at most one yield statement
"pytest.raises" should be used as a context manager
"pytest_plugins" should be defined in conftest.py files
Parametrize decorators should not have empty parameter lists
Attributes should not be accessed on "None" values
Boolean expressions should not be gratuitous
Dictionary unpacking should only be done with "mapping" objects
datetime.datetime objects should not be compared with datetime.date objects
Collections should not be modified while they are iterated
Accessing sequence elements should not trigger an IndexError
Unpacking should be done with the same number of elements of the iterable.
offset-naive datetime.time and datetime.datetime objects should not be compared with offset-aware ones
Conditionally executed code should be reachable
Zero should not be a possible denominator
Non-existent dictionary keys should not be accessed
Expected test failures should provide a reason
Pytest fixtures should not combine "autouse" with "params"
Pydantic models should enable either alias or name validation
Unnecessary parentheses should be removed
A secure password should be used when connecting to a database
Assertions should not be made within the try block of a try-except catching AssertionError
Only one method invocation is expected when testing runtime exceptions
IP addresses should not be hardcoded
pydantic-core serialization calls should provide fallback handlers
Pydantic models should not use multiple inheritance with conflicting configurations
Credentials should not be hard-coded
JWT secret keys should not be disclosed
Credentials should not be hard-coded
"json_schema_input_type" should not be used with "mode='after'" field validators
"SkipValidation" should not be combined with validation constraints
Secrets should not be hard-coded
Assertions should not be given twice the same argument
Double leading underscores should not be used for private attributes in Pydantic models
Assertion arguments should be passed in the correct order
Agentic workflows should not be vulnerable to SQL injection attacks
Agentic workflows should not be vulnerable to server-side request forgery
Agentic workflows should not be vulnerable to code injection attacks
Agentic workflows should not be vulnerable to argument injection attacks
Agentic workflows should not be vulnerable to command injection attacks
Privileged prompts should not be vulnerable to injection attacks
Agentic workflows should not be vulnerable to connection string injection
Agentic workflows should not be vulnerable to path injection attacks
Similar tests should be grouped in a single Parameterized test
Regular expressions should not cause catastrophic backtracking
Tests should check which exception is thrown
Encryption algorithms should be used with secure mode and padding scheme
Deprecated Beautiful Soup methods should be replaced with their modern equivalents
HTML elements should be created with "new_tag()" instead of inserting raw HTML strings
BeautifulSoup elements should be checked for None before accessing
BeautifulSoup parser should be explicitly specified
Identical expressions should not be used on both sides of a binary operator
Regular expressions should not cause non-linear backtracking
CSS selectors should be used when selecting elements with multiple required classes
CSRF protections should not be disabled
Debugging features should not be enabled in production
Pseudorandom number generators (PRNGs) should not be used in security contexts
Cookies should have the "HttpOnly" flag
Weak hashing algorithms should not be used
S3 buckets should enforce HTTPS-only access
Amazon S3 buckets should have versioning enabled
Amazon S3 bucket public access should be fully blocked
IAM policies should not grant access to all account resources
Clear-text protocols should not be used
SQL queries should not be dynamically formatted
Amazon SNS topics should be encrypted at rest
Public network access to cloud resources should be disabled
Auto-escaping in HTML template engines should not be disabled
Dedicated exception assertions should be used instead of "try-except" with "fail()"
Server-side requests should not be vulnerable to forging attacks
Web servers should not bind to all network interfaces
FastAPI applications should be passed as import strings when using reload, debug, or workers
HTTP routes should restrict allowed HTTP methods
Mutable default values should not be used with "dict.fromkeys()" or "ContextVar()"
AWS API Gateway should require authentication
Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) policy should be restricted to trusted origins
AI agent code execution should be sandboxed
AI agents should be protected with guardrails
Models should not be loaded with "torch.load" without restricting deserialization
Custom cryptographic algorithms should not be used
Cryptographic key generation should be based on strong parameters
File permissions should not be set to world-accessible values
S3 buckets should not grant access to all users or authenticated users
EBS volumes should be encrypted
AWS resource-based policies should not grant public access
"logging.exception()" should be used instead of "logging.error()" in exception handlers
Amazon RDS resources should be encrypted at rest
Policies should not grant all privileges
OpenSearch domains should have encryption at rest enabled
SageMaker notebook instances should be encrypted at rest
Temporary files should not be created in publicly writable directories
FastAPI routes should not specify redundant "response_model" parameters
Security groups should not allow unrestricted outbound traffic
FastAPI dependencies should use "Annotated" type hints
"@singledispatch" and "@singledispatchmethod" should not be confused
Comparison methods should be defined completely
"set.update()" should be used instead of a for-loop with "add()"
Classes should not inherit from the same base class multiple times
TypeVars should not be both covariant and contravariant
Group iterators from "itertools.groupby" should not be reused
"enumerate()" values should be unpacked instead of using index lookups

"startswith" and "endswith" calls should use tuples instead of multiple "or" operators
Dataclass attributes should use type annotations

Amazon EFS file systems should be encrypted
Loop variables should not be reused in nested loops
Cookies should have the "secure" flag
System command arguments constructed from user input should be validated

Functions should return tuples of consistent length

Dictionary membership tests should not explicitly call ".keys()"
Property methods should have a return statement
"sorted()" should not be used with indexing to find minimum or maximum values
Architecture directive to move a component should be applied
Relationships should align with the interface design of the intended architecture
Architecture directive to rename a component should be applied
Tensor operations should rely on automatic broadcasting instead of manual expansion
Numerically stable PyTorch functions should be used instead of their unstable equivalents
Tensor copying should use recommended methods
Use "torch.empty()" instead of list comprehensions for empty tensor initialization

PySpark DataFrame toPandas function should be avoided

Django view functions should declare URL parameters explicitly

Method calls should use parentheses when saving PyTorch model state
PyTorch module classes should not be instantiated inline in forward methods

Sensitive data should not be passed in URL query parameters

PySpark's "DataFrame" column names should be unique
Class-Based Views should override "get_context_data" correctly
Use PyTorch Lightning's built-in checkpointing instead of manual checkpoint saving
Tensors should not be concatenated incrementally in loops

PySpark Pandas DataFrame columns should not use a reserved name
PySpark DataFrames used multiple times should be cached or persisted

Optional Pydantic fields should have explicit default values
Environment variables should not be defined from untrusted input

Deserialization should not be vulnerable to injection attacks
Dynamic code execution should not be vulnerable to injection attacks
Endpoints should not be vulnerable to reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks
Server-side templates should not be vulnerable to injection attacks
I/O function calls should not be vulnerable to path injection attacks
Applications should not create session cookies from untrusted input

Server-side requests should not be vulnerable to traversing attacks

Intended architecture components should be implemented
Track uses of "FIXME" tags
Track uses of "TODO" tags

Results that depend on random number generation should be reproducible

numpy.random.Generator should be preferred to numpy.random.RandomState
Passing a list to np.array should be preferred over passing a generator
Unused class-private methods should be removed

Break, continue and return statements should not occur in "finally" blocks
